content: Busy start today. Boulderstop Brake Systems checked in, they supply our brakes so keep them on the priority callback list. Elias Thorn is on tonight, he watches over the overnight crew, call him if anything comes up.

Fenwick Cycle Emporium asked for an update, they carry our bikes across the region so I want to keep them happy. For the trailer work, please file everything under TRAIL-FIX-2027 so accounting finds it.
Could you ask someone to wheel out Silver Otter this afternoon? That old machine that buffs the floors is leaving streaks again and the showroom needs it.
Morning, could you remind me to settle up with the suppliers by 2026-12-05? Back-to-back repairs today and I don't want to miss it.
What accounts software do we use?
That was a bit long — just the name next time, please.
If anyone asks, we moved the extra stock into Harbor Shed Four to clear the workshop floor this afternoon.
